title: Rapid Convective Flare & Settlement Threat - Sonoma Basin
message: FRP peaked at 142.8 MW within 1.2km of Cobb settlement. High wind gusts (58 km/h NE) creating extreme spotting hazard.
recommended_action: Trigger emergency zone alert; coordinate structural defense with CalFire Unit Sonoma-Lake-Napa.

title: Uncontained Canopy Fire - Angeles National Forest
message: Thermal anomaly 76.5 MW detected in steep chaparral terrain with low humidity (18%). Potential rapid upslope run.
recommended_action: Deploy aerial reconnaissance to verify ignition perimeter and trail evacuation status.

title: Elevated Effusive Thermal Surge - Halema'uma'u
message: High radiant power (165.0 MW) detected over volcanic caldera. No residential threat; aviation plume advisory active.
location_name: Halema'uma'u Crater, Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, HI
recommended_action: Cross-reference USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory tiltmeter telemetry.
